prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with major changes hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, choose_path/redesign, finish/hint, finish/redesign, home/hint, and sign_in/copy, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Upload Photos Stage with Mascot Guidance: Redesign the photo upload screen using a stage layout featuring live mascot tips and clear framing guidelines. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with high completion time.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Add Desktop Companion Playground Intro Screen: Insert a new introductory screen before home intro showing how the pet lives on the desktop screen overlay. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support tickets mentioned confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Redesign Sign In Screen with Account Persistence Notice: Redesign the sign-in screen with a spotlight layout emphasizing account binding so pets are saved permanently. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, redesign] Redesign Waiting Screen with Interactive Mascot Tips: Redesign the waiting screen into a checklist layout showing active background generation steps and overlay tips. (why: Home wait time is very high (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Support System Requirements Hint: Display a system overlay compatibility hint on the path selection screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not displaying on desktop or app failing to launch, while initial step loses ~24% of users.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Sync Pet Protection Sign-In Headline: Update sign-in headline and body copy to stress permanent cloud pet protection against profile loss. (why: Sign-in step converts at 72.9% and 8 support messages reported pet reset issues after re-login.)
6: [finish, layout] Split View Layout for Home Intro Screen: Reformat the home intro screen into a split layout separating welcome text from quick desktop interaction steps. (why: Finish conversion is 64.8% with long drop times (median 395s), and users report confusion around controlling the pet.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop App Launch Troubleshooting Notification: Enable notification updates on the waiting screen with direct instructions if screen display takes longer than expected. (why: Waiting step takes high median time (201s) and support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on screen.)
